title: Model the News Database
prompt: Design article, author, bookmark, remote-key, and pending-mutation entities with DAOs, indices, relationships, atomic page replacement, and rollback tests.
successCriteria: Stable keys and uniqueness protect identity.
No network call runs inside a transaction.
Relationship and rollback behaviour is tested on Room.
hints: Name the authoritative state and durable identity before selecting a library API.
Test the operation after cancellation, duplication, or process recreation.

starterCode.code: @Database(entities = [ArticleEntity::class, AuthorEntity::class], version = 1) abstract class NewsDatabase : RoomDatabase()

solutionOutline: Model the data, operation, failure, and recovery states explicitly.
Implement the transactional path and prove every adverse success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic persistence or protocol tests.
Inspect durable state after interruption and retry.
